cod_assessment.rationale: No construction started 14 months after IA signing (May 2024 to Jul 2026). Wind project construction typically takes 18-24 months from ground-break. To meet 2027-07-31 COD, construction would need to start by ~Sep 2026 and proceed without delays — extremely tight. Two prior slips (3+ years in queue). NextEra is a credible developer but the timeline is aggressive given zero ground activity. Independent estimate pushes to 2028-Q2 as the more realistic target.
